name: What are the most popular materials for kitchen countertops and their pros and cons?

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular materials for kitchen countertops and their pros and cons?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular countertop materials include quartz, granite, marble, and laminate. Quartz is durable, non-porous, and comes in many colors, requiring low maintenance. Granite is also durable and heat-resistant, offering unique natural patterns, but it needs periodic sealing. Marble provides a luxurious look but is softer and more prone to scratching and etching, requiring careful maintenance. Laminate is the most affordable, offering various styles, but is less durable and heat-resistant than stone options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular countertop materials include quartz (durable, low maintenance), granite (durable, needs sealing), marble (luxurious, delicate), and laminate (affordable, less durable).
